description: Inspect one connected integration in depth: what the provider syncs, every event it can emit and when, every matching tag rule, which sequences trigger on those events, recent integration-specific activity, and prioritized recommendations. For Webflow, `webflowCapture` reports the exact selected native forms, retained field names, double-opt-in policy, list IDs, sequence toggle, webhook status, and schema fetch time; capture is off when its forms array is empty. `observedByAccount` and `accountLastSeenAt` are account-wide because event definitions can also be updated by another integration or the public events API; use the retained activity log for connection-specific delivery diagnosis. For Attio, an `attio_lists_unmapped` recommendation means nothing is mapped so nothing syncs, and `attio_inbound_sync_error` means changes made in Attio are not reaching Sequenzy — use get_attio_mapping then update_attio_settings; do not reconnect for that. Read-only; credentials are never returned. Get the id from list_integrations.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

name: get_integration

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `get_integration` MCP tool.

accountNeverReceivedEvents.description: Provider event names this account has never received from any source. This is not integration-specific delivery evidence.

activity.description: Webhook and sync activity over the last 24 hours: totals by status, stalled count, last activity time, and recent failures.

availableActions.description: Action ids callable on this integration right now, given its current state.

capabilities.description: What this provider does: category, connect method, what it syncs, every event it emits with when it fires, attributes it writes, supported actions, availability, and caveats. Null for a provider with no catalog entry.

events.description: Each event the provider emits, every matching tag rule and its conditions, listening sequences, and account-wide observation fields. Use activity for integration-specific delivery.

items.description: One item in the returned collection.

ingestion.description: What this integration does to the contact list: bulkSyncEnabled, supportsListTargeting, listTargeting (`company_default`, `none`, `specific`, or null when the provider ignores targeting), listIds (null means the workspace default lists), lists with their names, missingListIds for configured lists that have since been deleted and are therefore skipped, and a summary. When supportsListTargeting is false, the summary names defaultSubscriberListIds on get_company/update_company as the live-ingestion write path (null = every list, [] = none) and identifies provider-specific backfill exceptions such as PostHog history imports. Neither setting stops the provider's live webhook creating contacts.

integration.description: The connected integration: provider, display name, category, provider account ID, active and sync status, last sync time and error, allowlisted non-secret details, cohorts (Mixpanel and Amplitude: each synced cohort's id, name, tag, and sync times), and eventSettings (Amplitude). Credentials are never included.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

pixel.description: Shopify only: live storefront pixel state (installed, endpoint, endpointCurrent, configurationCurrent, healthy, error, dependentEvents). Null for providers without a pixel. When error is null and healthy is false, every dependentEvent is confirmed dark; an error means Shopify could not confirm the state.

recommendations.description: Prioritized problems and suggestions, each with a code, severity (error, warning, info), message, and a concrete action.

items.description: One item in the returned collection.

unusedEvents.description: Events the provider emits that no sequence triggers on. These are the concrete automation gaps for this integration.

items.description: Event name with no listening sequence.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
